lines.speaker: Lord Fedren
lines.text: Renoux, was it? I don't believe I've had the pleasure. New to court?

lines.speaker: Valette
lines.text: Newly arrived, my lord. My house keeps mostly to its own affairs.

choices.text: Ask about the Venture household's mood.

lines.speaker: Lord Fedren
lines.text: The Ventures? Tense. Lord Straff's been recalling household guard from the provinces all month — nobody's saying why.

lines.speaker: Lord Fedren
lines.text: The canal tax? A formality, officially. Unofficially, three houses are quietly moving goods around the toll stations before it takes effect.
